statement: The pinned Linux Nintendo Switch 2 consumer creates one left-half input device with ABS_X and ABS_Y spanning -32768 to 32767, a D-pad exposed as buttons, L and ZL, minus, stick click, capture, SL/SR and grip-side input. It conditionally offers FF_RUMBLE. No mouse or motion evdev axis is registered in that initialization path.

applicability.scope: Linux left USB consumer evdev buttons, axes and conditional output
